candidates.statement: Payment service returns 503 on POST /v1/authorizations, causing order to return 502 and gateway checkout to fail with 502.
candidates.uncertainty: Traces show payment 503 as proximate failure; root cause within payment (config, saturation, dependency) not observed. Logs excluded.

report.explanation: All checkout traces fail at payment POST /v1/authorizations with 503, propagating 502 through order to gateway. Inventory/redis succeed. Bounded candidate is downstream payment failure; deeper cause requires payment-side evidence.
missing_evidence: Payment service logs/metrics to determine why /v1/authorizations returns 503
Payment dependency topology and health (e.g., postgresql) to rule out db-pool-exhaustion or bad-configuration
